title: 1778 reference clone
family: Direct capture, raise-and-center, then powered handoff against a carrier-locked lower axle
notice: Architecture clone; dimensions are provisional, not measured 1778 CAD.
summary: Powered pickup retains one coral; presence triggers raising and mechanical centering. Present directly, then power the handoff against the locked lower contact.
advantage: One moving carrier captures, centers and presents; the intentional axle lock targets in-place spinning without a separate long V conveyor.
risk: Entry contact, retention and centering may fail. Receiver misalignment or wrong current-grip tuning can still throw coral; no measured geometry or physical pass.
firstTest: Hand-crank a flat-plate mockup with full pipe and bumper; compare locked/free lower axle, delayed receiver grip, entry offsets and centering during raise.
inspiration: research/2025-coral/1690-1778.md E07-E11: previously read firsthand post text reports powered pickup, presence-triggered raising, mechanical centering, axle locking and alignment/current-grip sensitivity. CAD, images and videos are link-only, NOT viewed or measured. No exact replica or verified coordinates; no 1690 four-bar or 1690/2056 V conveyor. Carrier motion, fingers and stop are proposals, not measured 1778 mechanisms.

states: Main provisional entry: horizontal crosswise, yaw90; robot-assisted recovery is not 360-yaw centering. Presence is not alignment. Solid contacts show raised offer; ghosts show capture at [-280,95]. A proposed 90-deg carrier turn follows the sampled arc; deployment linkage is unresolved, not a measured pivot. Lower axle stays locked to the moving carrier. Stop/nip retain coral while short fingers close mechanically during raise. Align receiver, release stop, power upper contact against locked lower; confirm manipulator current-grip before redeploy. Inhibit a second coral robot-wide. Flat routed plates, manual-machined shafts/blocks and printed guides; no accurate bends. Full piece/bumper dimensions are drawn; crosswise path has >75 mm bumper margin in 2D only. Entry, retention, centering closure, traction, swept hardware, current settings, jam recovery, stow and legality remain untested.
